comparison.objective: Move an aircraft flap lever through a gated quadrant into FULL; unlike tuning and locking a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Constrained lever manipulation through a gate and into a detent. Fine motion is shared generically, but there is no tool use or iterative response tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Lever must reach the FULL detent by the red stop and be released. Path/detent tolerances and spec versions are not given.
comparison.reason: Tests following a gated kinematic path and detent seating, not calibrated damping adjustment.
